claim: Nike's revenue was $39 billion in fiscal Q3 2024.
summary: Nike's fiscal Q3 2024 revenue was about $12.4B, not $39B; $39B is inconsistent with Nike's ~$51B annual scale for a single quarter.

sub_claims.text: Nike's revenue in fiscal Q3 2024 was $39 billion
sub_claims.stated_text: Nike's revenue was $39 billion in fiscal Q3 2024.
sub_claims.note: From general knowledge: Nike annual revenue FY2024 ~$51B with quarterly revenue ~$12-13B; Q3 FY2024 ended Feb 2024 was ~$12.4B, so $39B for a single quarter is false.
